findings.title: Both copper-line plug flanges intersect front-top’s aft valve tray
findings.description: The PETG outer flange on each copper-line plug stands at Y177..178, whereas the aft valve tray and its full-height foot extend to Y177.56. Each overlap occupies 8.5 mm of X and 61.475 mm of Z. The plugs are outside the foam-assembly envelope used by the ordinary enclosure pack checks. This is separate from the plugs’ intended fit in the foam-shell slots.

findings.title: Nameplate pocket bevel has 0.106066 mm face-normal clearance
findings.description: The pocket expands X/Z outline dimensions by 0.15 mm per side but applies the same 3 mm 45-degree back bevel as the nameplate. That makes the normal gap 0.15/sqrt(2). All four planar bevels and all four conical corner bevels measure this value. The square outer rim measures 0.15 mm and the bearing floor is deliberately coincident.

findings.title: Rear keystone model has 0.125 mm clearance on all four main pocket sides
findings.description: The 14.9 x24.4 mm pocket receives a body drawn 14.65 x24.15 mm because FIT_SLIP=.25 is subtracted once from each complete dimension. The resulting per-face air is .125 mm, verified at ±X and ±Z. These are main sliding pocket walls, separate from the intended capture catches and locating lip. The donor model is representative; measured purchased dimensions are needed to establish the physical fit.
